partnership_angle: Referral partner + sandbox tester — near-ideal profile. A brand-new (2025), founder-led, 1-10 person CPA boutique that already sells SOC 2 audits ON AWS Marketplace and offers an AWS-specific security-controls audit (Security Hub, GuardDuty, CloudTrail, Control Tower), so LoxeAI's AWS-native scan maps directly onto work they already do manually. As a young firm hungry for deal flow, a co-referral loop (LoxeAI sends scan users needing an auditor; Auditvisor sends pre-audit clients to the scan) is mutually valuable. Their alternative practice structure (separate attest and consulting entities) makes it clean for them to recommend a readiness tool without independence conflicts. One nuance: founder Pranav Tulsian has publicly posted 'AI in SOC 2 audits: a misleading promise' — he is skeptical of AI-replaces-auditor claims, so position LoxeAI strictly as pre-audit readiness scanning that feeds him better-prepared clients, not as audit automation.
pitch_note: Pranav — you already audit AWS Security Hub, GuardDuty, and CloudTrail configs by hand, and your posts make clear you have no patience for tools that overpromise on SOC 2. LoxeAI doesn't claim to audit anything: it's an AWS-native readiness scan that gets lean startups ~80% of the way before they ever call a CPA. Run it against your own or a sandbox AWS account on a 20-minute call — if the findings hold up to your standards, tell your pre-audit pipeline 'run this scan first,' and we'll route scan users who need a Type 1/Type 2 straight to Auditvisor.
